title: CORE-7345-adjacent: FAQ "Confirmation Statement" answer mislocated ~2600-2760px at 1024/1800 on /compare-packages/llp/
body:
Pre-existing defect found while running the CORE-7345 (T26) bug-lane coord regression gate
against /compare-packages/llp/. NOT caused by T26 — T26's diff is exactly one file
(src/blocks/ComparePackageTable/MobileCarousel.tsx), no changes to src/blocks/FAQs, confirmed via
git diff --name-only.

## Defect
On /compare-packages/llp/, the FAQ accordion's "What is a Confirmation Statement?" answer text
("Confirmation Statement") is mislocated by ~2600-2760px vertically at the 1024 and 1800
breakpoints — it renders far below its expected position (near the bottom of the page / footer
area) instead of inline within its accordion panel. Not present as a mislocation finding at 360
or 768 (may be breakpoint-conditional, e.g. columns/positioning CSS on the FAQ answer at
wider viewports).

## Evidence
qa-coord-live.ts run (T26's bug-lane coord gate), reports/T26-coord-live.json:
- @1024: [mislocated] <span> "confirmation statement" is 2603px out of place vs its block
  (clone 378,2603 vs block 0,0)
- @1800: [mislocated] <span> "confirmation statement" is 2761px out of place vs its block
  (clone 460,2762 vs block 0,1)

prod URL: https://www.rapidformations.co.uk/compare-packages/llp/
clone URL (preview used for the run): https://rapid-formations-clone-git-fix-core-7345-llp-f-3e851f-bsq-group.vercel.app/compare-packages/llp/

## What to do
1. Reproduce on /compare-packages/llp/ at 1024 and 1800 — open the "What is a Confirmation
   Statement?" FAQ item and check where its answer text actually renders vs the accordion panel.
2. Likely file: src/blocks/FAQs/Component.tsx (and/or the shared Collapsible component) — check
   for a CSS positioning/absolute-positioning bug specific to this one FAQ item's answer content,
   or a column-layout float that only manifests at 1024/1800.
3. Check whether this is llp-page-specific or reproduces on other compare-packages pages that
   share the same FAQ content ("What is a Confirmation Statement?" appears to be a common FAQ
   across compare-packages pages per the coord-live findings list).
4. Verify fix against live at 360/768/1024/1800 (mislocation only observed at 1024/1800 in this
   run, so those are the priority breakpoints, but confirm 360/768 aren't secretly affected too
   since the coord gate's whole-page scope may have masked smaller findings there).
